Three.js 0.187.0, MIT license (three-LICENSE.txt).
Unmodified ES modules copied from the existing projects/FCT/node_modules/three/build.
Self hosted and dynamically imported only when the PACA catalog is visible and
motion is allowed. No third party account, CDN, or build-time download is required.
To update, copy three.module.js, three.core.js, and LICENSE from one matching
Three.js release together, then run PACA checks and the browser motion QA.
